core_conduct: Serious violations of IHL in armed conflict
contextual_element: International or non-international armed conflict nexus
mental_element: Intent and knowledge under applicable framework
primary_sources: Rome Statute; Geneva Conventions; customary IHL
analysis_notes: Requires conflict classification, protected status, nexus, and specific underlying act.

core_conduct: Enumerated acts such as murder, enslavement, deportation, torture, rape, persecution, enforced disappearance
contextual_element: Widespread or systematic attack directed against a civilian population
analysis_notes: Does not require armed conflict under Rome Statute formulation.

core_conduct: Killing, serious harm, destructive conditions, preventing births, or forcibly transferring children
contextual_element: Protected national, ethnical, racial, or religious group
mental_element: Specific intent to destroy group in whole or in part
analysis_notes: Special intent is the central threshold issue.

core_conduct: Planning, preparation, initiation, or execution of manifest Charter violation by state force
contextual_element: Leadership crime connected to act of aggression
mental_element: Knowledge of factual circumstances establishing manifest violation
primary_sources: Rome Statute Article 8 bis; Kampala amendments
analysis_notes: Limited by jurisdictional and leadership constraints.
